title: Compliance Statement: Advance Liability Notices and Patient Charges, Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program
content:
**Statement.** When an item or quantity the customer wants on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program is expected not to be paid by the payer — above the tier's allowance without supporting documentation, an item the tier does not cover, or a replacement before the payer's replacement interval — Larkfield supplies it billable to the customer only after the customer signs the tier's liability notice for that item and quantity before the ship date. The customer signs it personally, and no Larkfield representative can sign it for them.

**By tier**

- *Original Medicare tier.* The notice is the CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131). The claim is still submitted to Medicare with the notice on file, and the customer becomes liable only for a line Medicare denies.
- *Medicare Advantage tier.* No notice can make the member liable; the member becomes liable only for an item for which the plan has issued a pre-service organization determination denial, recorded as a prior authorization denial for that item.
- *Self-pay tier.* No notice applies, because every item is priced at the Larkfield cash price.

**Patient charge types.** A patient charge is posted only as one of these charge types:

| Charge type | What it is |
|---|---|
| self-pay price | a self-pay refill at the cash price |
| standard shipping | a self-pay shipment below the free-shipping threshold |
| expedited shipping | a customer-requested expedite |
| non-covered item | an item or quantity covered by a signed liability notice, or by a Medicare Advantage organization determination denial, that the payer denied, charged at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned |

**Retired wording.** In the non-covered item line above, the words "charged at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned" are no longer in force for a non-covered item charge on test strips that is priced under the current non-covered test-strip charge basis; the charge is still made only for an item or quantity the payer denied. Every other patient charge, and every charge for an item other than test strips, stays at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned.

**Condition for a non-covered item charge.** A non-covered item charge requires a liability notice signed on or before the ship date covering that item and at least those units, or on the Medicare Advantage tier the plan's organization determination denial for that item; without it the amount is Larkfield's write-off and is never billed to the customer. The signed notice is read from the program's file; the customer's account of having signed is not enough.

**Cases (hypothetical)**

| Notice on file | Signed | Units covered vs units charged | Non-covered item charge allowed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | the day before the ship date | 4 covered, 4 charged | Yes |
| Yes | on the ship date | 4 covered, 3 charged | Yes |
| Yes | after the ship date | 4 covered, 4 charged | No — Larkfield's write-off |
| Yes | before the ship date | 2 covered, 4 charged | No — the notice does not cover at least those units |
| No | — | — | No — Larkfield's write-off |

superseded_clauses: charged at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned
